About this item

  • Material Note: Made of high-quality PVC. A normal material odor may exist upon unpacking, which is harmless and will dissipate quickly after ventilating for 1-2 days.
  • All-Round Protective Design: Features a double snap button + zipper closure, inner elastic cuffs, and elastic waist pants to prevent wind and rain from seeping in. The removable high-definition rain-blocking brim ensures clear visibility while protecting your face.
  • Nighttime Travel Safety: Equipped with a high-visibility reflective strip on the back, which significantly enhances visibility in low-light conditions, providing reliable safety for nighttime activities like motorcycle riding and commuting.
  • Comfortable & Durable Material: Made of tear-resistant and wear-resistant fabric with quick-dry and breathable properties to avoid stuffiness. It offers a unisex fit in XL and 2XL sizes, catering to different body types.
  • Multi-Scene Application: This all-in-one rain jacket and pants set is ideal for various outdoor activities, including motorcycle riding, fishing, hiking, camping, and outdoor work, making it your perfect all-weather companion.
